structure: Tail of the 855-page HSS Framework (book pp. ~805-855): Appendix G (California Education and the Environment Initiative: EP&C principles, then curriculum units listed under grade headings KINDERGARTEN...ELEVENTH GRADE, TWELFTH GRADE: PRINCIPLES OF AMERICAN DEMOCRACY / ECONOMICS, each with quoted standard codes e.g. 8.6.3 and a CURRICULUM UNIT description), Appendix H (Service-Learning), Works Cited, Framework Resources. No grade 9 in Appendix G. Per state guide, appendices G/H, Works Cited and Resources are backup; Appendix G grade sections are tagged with the grade they name.
